plain_summary: This page outlines the compulsory pilotage services provided by the Authority (Marine Services) at various ports. It specifies the tonnage basis for pilotage services and provides a table of tariff rates for normal entering or leaving the port, consisting of a basic fee per service and an additional charge per 100 tons or part thereof, varying by port. The page also details conditions under which a 50% surcharge is applicable, such as services outside ordinary working hours, vessel unreadiness, or late cancellation of service requests.

formulas.formula_as_written: Total Pilotage Dues = Basic Fee (Per Service) + (Ceiling(Vessel Tonnage / 100) * Rate per 100 tons)
formulas.what_it_calculates: The total pilotage dues for normal entering or leaving the port.
formulas.rounding_or_conditions: The 'Per 100 tons or part thereof' implies rounding up to the nearest 100 tons for the calculation of the tonnage component. A 50% surcharge applies under specific conditions.
